topic: Major Biomolecule Categories and Building Blocks
key_concepts: Four main classes of biomolecules are carbohydrates, lipids, proteins, and nucleic acids
Proteins are built from amino acids joined by peptide bonds
Nucleic acids include DNA and RNA
Nucleic acids are built from nucleotides, which contain bases
Lipids include fats such as butter and margarine
Carbohydrates and lipids are energy sources, with lipids having more calories per gram
Proteins and nucleic acids contain nitrogen
